observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with theatrical lighting and a backdrop depicting a French street scene, in front of a seated audience at tables.
observation.dancers: Five female dancers in a group.
observation.formation_and_space: A line formation across the stage, spreading out or grouping together while facing the audience.
observation.posture: Upright torso, erect posture, with upright weight on legs.
observation.footwork: Brisk stepping, high kicks, and leaping on beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out or waving wide, hands grasping the sides of their skirts to lift and flutter them.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso mostly upright, hips swaying slightly with high kicks.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: High leg kicks, jumping splits, kneeling on the floor, and spinning turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate red, white, and blue ruffled skirts, corsets, and feathered headdresses.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact individual footwork details are obscured by fast movement and skirt fabric.

signature_moments.what: Dancers kick their legs high into the air sequentially while holding and shaking their ruffled skirts.
Dancers line up horizontally facing away from the audience, bend forward, and raise one leg straight up in the air.
